requests.prompt:
Edit Picture 1 (图1). Render the emblem as a compact small-scale icon that carries the SAME premium design language as the full-size logo: the segmented circular C-shaped ring of four arc segments divided by thin crosshair gaps, and the small four-pointed sparkle star at the exact center, with the original proportions, segment gap widths, corner radii and star proportions unchanged.

Surface material: the same hard carbon fiber composite in a clearly defined 2x2 twill weave — distinct legible tow bundles running diagonally across every segment and across the sparkle, crisp defined weave edges, the tows a shade lighter and a shade darker than the base color so the weave reads as structure within the color and never as gold, silver or any other metal. Matte and non-reflective, never foil, never chrome, never a specular sheen or glossy highlight, never a bold black or grey checkerboard.

Outline: a crisp, clearly visible darker edge line along the entire silhouette — a fine, precise dark contour around every segment and around the central sparkle, so the logo's outline stays clearly readable even at 16 pixels. Not a heavy stroke, a precise hairline of a deeper chartreuse, never black.

Tone: keep the tonal depth of the full logo — bright chartreuse where the light strikes the upper-left, falling to a richer chartreuse in the lower-right — but compress the range so that even the darkest tone remains a vivid, clearly yellow-green chartreuse, never a dull dark olive, never a muddy brown-olive, never washed out or pastel. The overall average must read as a bright, punchy yellow-green, not a muted mid-tone.

Hard, crisp, precisely cut edges.

The emblem floats isolated, with no cast shadow, no drop shadow, no contact shadow, no floor, no reflection and no glow.

Background: completely flat, uniform pure white (#FFFFFF) from edge to edge, with no gradient, no vignette, no texture, no falloff and no shadow of any kind.

Exclude: metallic leaf, gold foil, chrome, aluminum, silver, polished metal, mirror surfaces, glossy varnish, plastic sheen, specular highlights, lens flare, bloom; any shadow, floor, reflection or glow beneath the emblem; 3D bevels, chamfers, extruded edges or embossing; flat pastel or washed-out lemon yellow; dull dark olive or muddy brown tones; film grain, noise, color banding; text, lettering, extra shapes, people, props, watermarks.
